body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> NYX introduced a custom-made illuminated jacket and skirt during CES2007.

It features a PDP panel with a brilliant colors of built-in LED lightings and 8~10 hours lasting battery per charge. The PDP panel can display digital clock, picture mode downloading from PC. Other features include wireless connectivity and Bluetooth.
Suggested price is from $900 to $2,000 depends on various lighting and performance option. It is washable after removing PDP and battery.
